case.meaning: First true branch wins; null policy is explicit.

cast.meaning: Declared dtype conversion; temporal text requires parse_datetime instead.

clip.meaning: Clip exact numeric bounds; missing/reversed bounds fail.

coalesce.meaning: First nonnull expression in declared order; all-null returns null.

concat.meaning: Concatenate strings; ignore with all-null inputs produces empty string.

contains.meaning: Explicit literal or Rust-regex search; null remains null.

convert_time_zone.meaning: Represent the same instant in a declared zone; naive timestamps require explicit localization first.

date_part.meaning: Native temporal component; weekday is ISO Monday=1 through Sunday=7; timestamp zone is retained.

datetime_shift.meaning: Calendar accepts d/w/mo/q/y; elapsed uses fixed durations. Calendar DST ambiguity fails; month clipping and duration truncation require explicit permission. Null remains null; representational overflow fails.

extract.meaning: Extract a Rust-regex capture; no match returns null.

is_in.meaning: Exact typed set membership; null matching is explicit.

length.meaning: Unicode character count, not bytes; null remains null.

literal.meaning: Exactly typed native literal; temporal strings use ISO syntax.

lower.meaning: Unicode lowercase; String input, null remains null.

replace.meaning: Replace first/all matches; replacement captures require explicit permission.

round.meaning: Explicit decimal rounding rule; null remains null.

slice.meaning: Bounded character slice; negative offset counts from the end.

split.meaning: At most max_splits literal splits; final element retains the remainder; empty elements remain.

trim.meaning: Trim outer Unicode whitespace; String input, null remains null.

upper.meaning: Unicode uppercase; String input, null remains null.

when.meaning: Choose a branch; every branch must be valid independently.
